headline: Check Point PHP2Shell and N-central zero-days exploited; Apify confirms customer data accessed; SilentAir intercepts SMS

bullets.text: New: Apify confirms customer data was accessed in a cyberattack. Dark Reading reports the Binance breach attackers used a known weakness and missing controls; the US says it seized $1.2 billion in stolen crypto. Quantum Systems drones are flying again after a malware scare.

SilentAir intercepts calls and SMS from inside Asian mobile networks, including SMS two-factor codes, and spies on Taiwanese users. Accounts relying on SMS codes in the region should be treated as exposed.
PHP2Shell (5 outlets): Check Point zero-day CVE-2026-123039 is exploited for root on gateways; attackers deploy a TSGA backdoor and wipe ESXi files. No fixed release version is on the board.
N-central (PoC, 6 outlets): the N-able '4EverAble2Shell' zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; 21 servers infected, 19 on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. No CVE or fix is on the board.

MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions; nearly 50 organizations report breaches. Still active: SignDrop Windows CLFS zero-day, 4,800 GitHub accounts hijacked, Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618, Xen Orchestra exploits, Fireworks AI breach.

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; last 7 days run 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Apify users: rotate API tokens and integration secrets stored with Apify and watch for follow-up notices from the vendor.
Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039, limit gateway management to trusted networks, and hunt for TSGA backdoor indicators.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, confirm third-party extensions are disabled, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
Move admin and high-value accounts off SMS 2FA to app-based or hardware keys, starting with users in Taiwan and Asian telecom regions.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618; review GitHub sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets.
